401_retry_scope: Each POST constructs a fresh request-scoped header owner. Header is dropped after run or preceding transport error before returned401 handling; existing reauth/reseal/session update logic is unchanged. Ordinary typed401 control is distinct from a full attested refresh proof.

filesystem_scope.OS_child_kill_wait: Shared supervisor attempts kill/wait; OS failures remain best effort. The absolute has-reaped comment was corrected before freeze.
filesystem_scope.cleanup: Drop removes fixed file and directory nonrecursively, best effort. SIGKILL/power loss/OOM abort or filesystem failure can leave a private artifact; no secure erase guarantee.
filesystem_scope.permissions_note: Unix creation modes can be narrowed by umask; metadata/native tests should report actual mode, not assume universal chmod/ACL/platform guarantees.
filesystem_scope.trust_boundary: Default trusted temp parent/cooperative filesystem. SameUID/root can read or replace names/memory; hostile TMPDIR or parent replacement is not solved. O_EXCL rejects existing leaf symlinks; private directory protects against ordinary other-user traversal.

native_acceptance_requested: Extract actual frozen modifiedPOST/helper, observe only owned curl PID at a peer barrier, assert token absent from argv but exact same body/header on wire.
Some/None, ordinary production-shape hex and generic test token; compare representation edge cases if documenting general byte compatibility.
Actual0600file/0700directory, lifetime through owned child supervision, cleanup after success/spawn/IO/timeout/error; no SIGKILL guarantee.
MalformedCR/LF/NUL fixed redaction before child/peer/filesystem admission; retain body/URL/deadline guards.
Typed401 then fresh attempt with a new owner/token; no whole handshake, real token minting, proof or attestation acceptance.

public_token_contract.CR_LF_NUL_rejection: Necessary fixed-redacted representation rejection for a line-oriented headerfile; done before filesystem creation.
public_token_contract.nonUnix_Some: Explicit fixed error before spawn; no token-in-argv fallback.
public_token_contract.production_session_token: 0x-prefixed hex Keccak digest from public handshake::session_token source; no execution or actual secret read.
public_token_contract.public_with_session_token: Generic Option<String> API remains; fake ASCII/Unicode/space values are not forced to hex grammar.

scope: Read-only public source and frozen synthetic native evidence; no test/build/network/service/privateconfig/source/old/outside mutation. Only this new ignored design receipt is written.
